summary: Iteration 12 — Fate Passport (Phase 1) end-to-end + per-chip Google search fix regression. BACKEND (pytest 14/14 pass, /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_passports_and_search.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter12.xml): POST /api/passports returns a 6-char code for valid 4-stop payload; 2-stop payload => 422 as required; 15-stop payload truncates to 10 (Pydantic validator _valid_passport_stops caps v[:10] AFTER accepting the request, so no error — GET confirms total=10). GET /api/passports/{code} returns stops/stamps/stamped/total/completed_at; unknown code => 404. Stamping: GPS with far-away coords (LA vs NYC stop) => 409 with 'get closer' message; GPS within the 0.4-mi ring => 200 with verified=true; source=manual => verified=false; double-stamping same stop returns already_stamped=true and does NOT increment; unknown stop_id => 404; stamping the last stop sets completed_at. DELETE /api/passports/{code}/stamp/{stop_id} pulls the stamp and $set completed_at=null. Places regression: category=food cuisines=[Breakfast,Filipino] @ZIP 10001 => zero Subway leaks, every item's category=food and cuisine ∈ {Breakfast, Filipino} (per-chip labeling working), and both chips appear within the first 6 items (interleaved via zip_longest). category=explore cuisines=[Lighthouses] @28782 radius 150 mi => no restaurant leaks (banned keywords 'restaurant/diner/pizzeria/steakhouse/burger' absent). category=fuel cuisines=[Bus Stations] @10001 => transit results with category=fuel and no restaurant names. FRONTEND @ 390x844 (preview URL): Skip intro dismisses onboarding; passport-mode-toggle enables passport-picker; sizes 3-10 all render (passport-size-3..10 present). Selecting size 4 + mode-explore + zip-input=10001 + spin-roulette-button => navigation to /p/7VGXDN (real code), passport-title 'Adventure Passport', passport-progress '0/4', 4 passport-stop-N cards, passport-share button present. Manual stamp (passport-stamp-manual-0) => progress 1/4, 'Stamped manually' label appears; passport-unstamp-0 => 0/4. Stamping all 4 stops => passport-complete-banner appears ("Passport complete — Every stop stamped"). Full page reload preserves 4/4 progress AND the complete banner (server-persisted). Home nav via passport-home-link + re-enabling the passport toggle shows my-passports containing code 7VGXDN as a link that reopens that passport. GPS button (passport-stamp-gps-0) with permissions revoked via context.grant_permissions([]) does NOT crash the page and does NOT increment progress; page remains on the passport route with the manual button still functional (manual stamp after denial succeeds). Mutual exclusion verified: turning passport ON shows passport-picker; turning group-mode-toggle ON hides passport-picker; turning crawl-mode-toggle ON shows crawl-type-picker; turning passport-mode-toggle ON while crawl is on hides crawl-type-picker and shows passport-picker. Fuel & Go: mode-toggle grid shows 'Fuel & Go' as the label; the Fuel tab renders 3 chip groups (Fuel & Charging, Wash & Service, Getting Around) with 16 cuisine-filter chips total (Diesel/EV Charging/Gas Station/Truck Stop; Car Wash/Detailing/Hand Wash Car Wash/Self-Serve Car Wash/Touchless Car Wash; Bike Rentals/Bike Share/Bus Stations/Park & Ride/Scooter Rentals/Scooter Share and one more). Food regression: mode-food + ZIP 10001 + spin reveals Altair Restaurant NYC (real Google result) with the Order/Delivery dropdown-trigger present. Zero console/page errors across every flow.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/passports.py — _get_or_404 upper-cases and trims code to 8 chars so lower/whitespace input still resolves; the 'already_stamped' branch (lines 81-82) short-circuits BEFORE the $push, guaranteeing idempotency at the app layer (there is no unique index on stamps.stop_id in the doc, but the pre-check works for the single-writer path). completed_at is set optimistically via len(stamps)+1 >= len(stops); if a concurrent stamp lands between _get_or_404 and update_one, both writers would $push, potentially over-counting. For a passport (multi-day, single user tapping) this is fine, and unstamp resets completed_at anyway. No PII persisted — stops carry Google name/address only.

backend/routes/places.py — _matches_cuisine + _SIGHTSEEING_CHIPS gate correctly drops 'The Lighthouse Restaurant' style false-positives; _NON_SHOP_TYPES (line 26) is the food/drink kill-list applied to shops/explore/fuel results in _place_to_result. Per-chip fan-out is capped at _MAX_CUISINE_QUERIES=4 to keep Google spend bounded; each chip's results carry its OWN 'cuisine' label back to the client (line 251 uses `cuisine or prettify_type(...)`), so the frontend's chip legend now matches what actually matched.

frontend/src/pages/Passport.jsx — Well-scoped component (247 lines). rememberPassport() writes the code+label+mode to localStorage (ff_passports, capped at 12) so my-passports on Home stays in sync without a server auth layer. Share falls back from navigator.share to clipboard.writeText and swallows user-cancelled AbortError. Geolocation error branch (line 69-77) is exhaustive and does NOT re-throw — matches the 'GPS denied doesn't crash' requirement.

frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx — passportMode/groupMode/crawlMode mutual exclusion works via three separate onClick handlers that call setX(false) on the other two before flipping the current one; verified via preview browser (turning any of the three on hides the other two's pickers). The passport spin-roulette handler (lines 358-382) reuses the search results, shuffles, slices to passportSize, POSTs /api/passports and navigates — no extra loader state, uses the same setResults branch, so 'no spots' errors and the passport branch share the same failure toast.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested Passport + Fuel & Go + mutual-exclusion + regression checks)

seed_data_creation: Test runs create ephemeral TEST_ passport codes; one live passport code (7VGXDN) was created against the preview backend and left in place (mode=explore, 4 real Google stops, currently stamped 4/4 by the test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Passport backend & UI both verified. Testing note: (a) The onboarding intro is now on the initial home load — always click the 'Skip intro' button (button:has-text("Skip intro")) before interacting with passport-mode-toggle or its overlay will swallow clicks. (b) Chip group headers ('Fuel & Charging' etc.) are rendered with CSS text-transform:uppercase — do case-insensitive text matches OR check via [data-testid="cuisine-toggle-more-<group lowercased>"] instead of innerText. (c) The 'more' button on a group only renders when items.length > 10; the current Fuel groups (4/5/7 items) legitimately have no 'more' button. (d) When testing the far-away GPS 409, do NOT use the /crawls/{code}/checkin endpoint by mistake — passports use POST /api/passports/{code}/stamp with body {stop_id, lat, lng, source:'gps'}, and 'get closer' is in detail.lower(). (e) The Passport spin path bypasses the single-reveal branch entirely, so passportMode + spin-roulette-button navigates directly to /p/<code>; there is no intermediate loading modal. (f) pytest runs under the repo pytest.ini which enables xdist by default — always pass `-o addopts=""` for tests that share fixtures across module-scoped state.
